The trail, the well · was 0 → 0 · level
to the Ley Line (the East Mouth)
as built: four flights spiral to the top
open ground (a clearing, a field, a yard)
the ground and the Tower as they stand today (read from the room)
- - a FOUND way up (a climb, a trunk, a ladder)
┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
▒ a STAIR (real stair pieces cut in the face; walked both ways)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle = a RAMP square, pointing uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk works today: no new rule.

Plot lines by district: T = Babel · Z = Technoticlan (not planned yet) · R = the trail (the route kit's). Dashes = a new plot. Orange dots = the ways out of the room; their squares keep today's height. A PROPOSAL: nothing is built from it until mondo
